script:
for line in "42" "hello" "a1b2" ""; do
  if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:digit:]]+$ ]]; then
    echo "$line -> integer"
  elif [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:alpha:]]+$ ]]; then
    echo "$line -> word"
  elif [[ -z "$line" ]]; then
    echo "$line -> empty"
  else
    echo "$line -> mixed"
  fi
done
stdout:
42 -> integer
hello -> word
a1b2 -> mixed
 -> empty
